M-XUNIT.Purpose: The offline xunit suite: framework facts provable without the game (models, generators, weaver, tools) as a deployed test assembly driven by the xunit harness (M-OP-TEST).

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Source/FlexVerse.Test/Xunit: scenario classes grouped by tested project (FlexVerse, SourceGenerators, PropertyWeaver, FlexTools) plus the Shims and Fixtures support code.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Namespace-per-project convention (FlexVerse.Test, FlexVerse.Test.SourceGenerators, ...) so the harness filter selects by project.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Harness mechanics (filter parsing, exit codes, build) — owned by M-OP-TEST / M-DOTNET.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: In-game behavior — owned by the pickle suite (M-PICKLE) and M-EXPLORER.

Requirements.REQ-001: One top-level directory per tested project, flat inside; an aspect suffix (.weaver / .semantics / .retarget) splits a topic, never a new directory.
Requirements.REQ-002: Only members whose code paths never touch RimWorld/Verse/UnityEngine are exercised; Unity-free FlexTools sources are compiled directly into the test project.
Requirements.REQ-003: ShimCompleteness guards the Unity shim surface of M-TEST-RUNTIME-SHIMS.
Requirements.REQ-004: R03–R09 headless tests are authored verification fixtures; presence of a test source does not imply it has been executed or that Unity/Waylith native IMGUI behavior is accepted.

Inputs.IN-001: A dotnet test filter expression selecting classes or namespaces.

Outputs.OUT-001: xunit pass/fail verdict == dotnet test exit code, consumed by M-OP-TEST.
